Name: Absolute Executioner
Description: An executioner's sword wreathed in spinning gears and sparking blades. Unleashes a multi-hit downward strike. Hold to increase the number of hits.

Name: Battle Axe: Idris's Conceit
Description:
A special axe that generates a temporal force field.

Striking with the axe creates a wide-area shock wave. The axe's swing can easily break through shields, and its force field gradually builds up the slow status ailment.

Name: Bloodreaver Blade
Description: A long blade that slashes foes with a flash-draw strike. Hold to enter a ready stance. Release to perform a slash draw. The timing of the release affects both motion and power. A well-timed release delivers a significantly stronger blow.

Name: Manus Rapacis
Description: A grotesque hand that channels the Resurgence's power into a searing beam of light. Fires a long-range laser directly ahead in a straight line. While firing, you can use to adjust the beam's direction.

Name: MK Rosenritter
Description: Twin triple-barreled Gatling guns that turn a wide area into a bullet storm. Ready the gun and move the camera to aim, then fire by pressing . You can also move while aiming. Sustains continuous fire as long as the button is held and ichor remains.

Name: Statesman's Longbow
Description: A bow that fires arrows of light at incredible speed. Ready the bow and move the camera to aim, then press to fire. You can also move while aiming. Holding increases its power.

Name: Warhammer of the Fool
Description: A fire-belching hammer with three forms. Initiates a chain of attacks starting from a heavy downward swing. : Cast forma. After use, hold and press : Trigger a two-hit combo. After combo, hold and press , , or : Trigger a unique finisher move. The finisher changes depending on which additional button is pressed.

Name: Wings of Eternity
Description:
The twisted wings of Valentin, transfigured into forma.

Rains countless spears of light from above, bombarding a wide area.
